statements.statement: The service is CPT 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The submitted records support the medical necessity determination
